exposure: Placental histopathological changes (maternal vascular malperfusion, avascular villi, VUE, chorangiosis, percentage of intact terminal villi, capillarization of villi)
cohort: The study included 50 cases of growth-restricted preterms, comprising 24 with early-onset fetal growth restriction and 26 with late-onset fetal growth restriction.
finding: Reduced CTG baseline variability and absence of accelerations were associated with poor neonatal outcomes and specific placental histopathological changes, including maternal/fetal vascular malperfusion and decreased villi integrity and capillarization.
